name: Paper type
question: What type of paper is this?

labels.name: conceptual
labels.definition: Builds theory or an argument without new data: propositions, frameworks, theory synthesis.

labels.name: empirical quantitative
labels.definition: Tests hypotheses or estimates effects with numerical data: surveys, archival or panel data, experiments, statistics.

labels.name: empirical qualitative
labels.definition: Builds or elaborates theory from qualitative data: interviews, observation, documents, coded and interpreted.

labels.name: mixed methods
labels.definition: Combines quantitative and qualitative data and analysis in one design.

labels.name: systematic literature review
labels.definition: Reviews a body of literature with an explicit, replicable search, selection and synthesis procedure.

labels.name: meta-analysis
labels.definition: Pools effect sizes from earlier quantitative studies statistically.

labels.name: case study
labels.definition: Studies one or a few bounded cases in depth, in their context, as the design of the paper.

labels.name: methodological
labels.definition: Develops, compares or critiques a research method, measure or analytical technique.

labels.name: editorial
labels.definition: An editorial, commentary, introduction to a special issue or a short essay.
